business_summary: Beijing Zodi Investment Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in real estate development business in China. It is also involved in direct investment, including direct equity investment and real estate development investment; investment advisory; food and beverage management; finance lease; and provision of technical services. The company was formerly known as Beijing Soft Rock Investment Group Corporation and changed its name to Beijing Zodi Investment Co., Ltd. in March 2018. Beijing Zodi Investment Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
business_summary_ko: Beijing Zodi Investment Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국에서 부동산 개발 사업을 영위하고 있습니다. 또한 직접 지분 투자, 부동산 개발 투자 등 직접 투자에도 참여하고 있습니다. 투자 자문; 식품 및 음료 관리; 금융리스; 기술 서비스 제공. 이 회사는 이전에 Beijing Soft Rock Investment Group Corporation으로 알려졌으며 2018년 3월에 Beijing Zodi Investment Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Beijing Zodi Investment Co., Ltd.는 1993년에 설립되었으며 중국 베이징에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
